caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing upright, dressed in period clothing. She wears a long, full brown dress that reaches the floor and has long sleeves. Over her shoulders is a pale cream-colored shawl tied in the front. On her head, she has a dark brown bonnet with a ribbon tied under her chin and pale trim framing her face. Her face is light-skinned with red lips and blush on the cheeks, and her hair is brown, with some visible strands under the bonnet. Both hands are partially visible, with the right hand unclothed and colored pinkish, while the left hand is covered with a white glove. The background is plain and unadorned, and the artist's name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is written in small uppercase letters in the lower right portion of the drawing. The overall color palette is dominated by muted browns, creams, and pale flesh tones.
title: Quaker Costume Doll
